Purpose: 125% (120 DPI) and 150% (144 DPI) watch-ui-journeys on a disposable offline clone, per docs/agents/golden-renderer.md 'DPI validation'.

Clone.Name: gpt_win11_ticket23_dpi
Clone.DisksIsolated: Clone disks confined to F:\ticket23-dpi-import-20260819; asserted not shared with the source before boot.

HostConstraintEncountered.Problem: The clone imported correctly but could not start: the host has 15.3 GB RAM and gpt_win11 holds a static 4 GB, so two 4 GB VMs do not fit.
HostConstraintEncountered.Resolution: gpt_win11 was gracefully shut down for the duration of the DPI phase and restarted afterwards. This is a power cycle, not a calibration change, and the runbook forbids running two desktop suites in parallel anyway.
HostConstraintEncountered.SideEffectObserved: gpt_win11 carried a Hyper-V automatic checkpoint, which merges into the parent VHDX on shutdown. Its disk path therefore changed from the .avhdx to gpt_win11.vhdx. Guest state is preserved by the merge; nothing was lost.

Runs.EffectiveDpiProof: Interactive environment report before and after the suite: Dpi=120, ScalePercent=125, DesktopWidth=1920, DesktopHeight=1080, Interactive=true, SessionId=1, ExplorerInSession=true, InputDesktop=true, Culture=zh-CN, RenderingMode=SoftwareOnly.

Interactive environment report before and after the suite: Dpi=144, ScalePercent=150, DesktopWidth=1920, DesktopHeight=1080, Interactive=true, SessionId=1, ExplorerInSession=true, InputDesktop=true, Culture=zh-CN, RenderingMode=SoftwareOnly.

ReflowObservations.125-percent-03-demand-series-detail: Page scrolls vertically; the series grid and the event grid each carry their own horizontal scrollbar rather than clipping columns. Title bar minimise/maximise/close, the navigation rail, the pagination row (previous / page number / 跳转 / next) and the detail card's 完整证据 command are all fully rendered.
ReflowObservations.150-percent-06-error-search-variant-a: The three-card layout collapses to a single column and scrolls inside the card. Title bar buttons, navigation rail, the 活动错误 page-state badge and the category search field remain fully rendered; the long Host snapshot header line is ellipsised by the text layout rather than clipped by the container.

ScopeHonesty.Claim: These runs prove reflow and scrolling under 125% and 150% scaling at the real interactive DPI.
ScopeHonesty.NotClaimed: They do not exercise the 720 epx minimum width. The narrowest client they reach is 960x600 epx at 150%.
WhereTheFloorIsCovered: MesIngest.Tests/WatchV2ProductionShellTests.cs - Production_shell_keeps_native_caption_commands_accessible_and_reflows_at_720_epx and Demand_series_page_keeps_filter_list_exact_paging_and_evidence_journeys_accessible_at_720_epx set window.Width = 720 directly (host suite, 919 tests).
MesIngest.Watch.UiTests/WatchTicket22ResponsiveIntegrationTests.cs - sets window.Width = 720 for the Error Search and CurrentIngestAttention surfaces (guest watch-vm-tests, 227 tests).

Cleanup.ScopeGuard: The cleanup script refuses to delete a directory that holds any disk of the live gpt_win11. This matters because the calibrated VM's own disk lives under F:\ticket23-font-import-20260818, a directory left by the earlier font session; a broad cleanup would have destroyed the golden machine.
